panels.title: LLM requests/h by vendor
panels.description: Request count per hour — increase(llm_request_total[1h]), readable at low traffic volumes.

targets.expr: sum by (vendor) (rate(llm_request_total{app=~".*-production",status="error", vendor=~"$vendor", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (vendor) (rate(llm_request_total{app=~".*-production", vendor=~"$vendor", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, vendor) (rate(llm_request_duration_seconds_bucket{app=~".*-production", vendor=~"$vendor", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Cost (USD)
panels.description: Total LLM spend over the selected dashboard time range, overall and per vendor.

targets.expr: sum by (vendor, model) (rate(llm_tokens_total{app=~".*-production", direction="input", vendor=~"$vendor", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (vendor, model) (rate(llm_tokens_total{app=~".*-production", direction="output", vendor=~"$vendor", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (vendor, model) (rate(llm_tokens_total{app=~".*-production", direction=~"cache_read|cache_creation", vendor=~"$vendor", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Requests/h — $model
panels.description: Hourly LLM API calls for this model, split by vendor and status.
